facts: Official name Halmstad C - Påarp.
Official distance 14.6 km.
Difficulty Grön, normalized here as easy.

Official route description follows Nissan, an industrial area, Östra stranden, Hagöns naturreservat, E6, Fylleån, Trönninge ängars naturreservat, Steglebacken, Slyngestenen, Påarps badplats and Påarps gravfält.

officialSources.name: Länsstyrelsen Halland: Hagön
facts: Hagön nature reserve is in Halmstad municipality, 78.5 ha, protected since 1973.
Visitor rules prohibit loose dogs, tenting/caravan setup, fires, vegetation/natural-object damage, wildlife disturbance and motor vehicles outside designated road/parking.

officialSources.name: Länsstyrelsen Halland: Trönninge ängar
facts: Trönninge ängar is a 151 ha Halmstad nature reserve formed in 2018; parts were bird-protection area from 1981 and Fylleån is Natura 2000 since 2005.
Most of the reserve has year-round access/stay prohibition except specified roads, paths, facilities, viewing structures and edge/water corridors.
Rules include no loose dogs, no tents, no caravans/campervans 22:00-06:00, fire only at designated places and no parking outside designated places.

officialSources.name: Destination Halmstad: Östra stranden
facts: Östra stranden is a shallow sandy beach about 4 km from central Halmstad.
Destination Halmstad notes services, playground and Hagön hiking opportunities in beach forest/dunes.

officialSources.name: Destination Halmstad: Påarp och Laxvik strand
facts: Påarpsstranden is described as a 300 m sandy beach with dunes.
Page notes Påarps gravfält from the Iron Age nearby and that toilets are available.
Page last updated 2026-03-09.

officialSources.name: Halmstad dog and horse beach rules
facts: Dogs are prohibited on Halmstad official bathing beaches 1 May-15 September.
Horses/riding are prohibited on official bathing beaches 1 May-15 September and prohibited year-round in coastal sand dunes.

Dogs are allowed on non-official beaches under close control.

Naturvårdsverket general rule requires extra control of dogs in nature 1 March-20 August.
horseRules: Horses/riding are prohibited on official bathing beaches between 1 May and 15 September.
Riding in sea-shore dunes is never allowed.
campingRules: Hagön prohibits tenting and caravan setup.
Trönninge ängar prohibits tenting and restricts caravans/campervans 22:00-06:00.
Halmstad local public-place rules allow camping or equivalent overnighting in vehicles only at municipality-designated places/times.

fireRules: Trönninge ängar allows fires only at designated places.
Halmstad fire-risk page said no brandriskbedömning was active as accessed 2026-04-30; normal assessment season is May-September.

seasonalAndCurrentness: Several K8 beach toilets are seasonal: Gröningen Östra stranden, Majstångsvägen, Östra stranden/Lilla Köpenhamn, Påarp and one Laxvik toilet.

Toalett busstationen Halmstad, Toalett Trönninge, Toalett Laxvik Strandängsvägen öppen året om and Toalett Södra vägen Halmstad slott are official year-round toilet records, but opening hours/fees can vary.
Halmstad C/Fredsgatan/Stationsgatan works are active access/currentness context around the start through planned 2026-09-30, but not an official K8 closure from current evidence.
Trafikverket Fredsgatan walking/cycle tunnel is a longer-term Halmstad C access planning watch through 2026-2030.
Södra infarten/hamn/Östra stranden and Östra stranden development/climate-adaptation projects are future works/currentness watches, not current K8 closures from available evidence.
hazards: Urban/shared-use paths, station traffic, industrial approach and possible Halmstad C worksite changes near the start.
E6 underpass, Fylleån crossing and railway-adjacent Trönninge ängar corridor require staying on marked/allowed paths.
Trönninge ängar wet meadows/floodplain may flood seasonally and have strict access restrictions to protect birds.
Coastal exposure, wind, soft sand, dunes and beach/heathland conditions around Östra stranden, Hagön and Påarp.
Red flag at lifeguarded Halmstad beaches means dangerous bathing; bathing is user responsibility.
